tools.name: portvan_catalog
tools.description: List Portvan plans, prices and payment rules (USDT TRC20, exact amount). Free, no side effects.

tools.name: portvan_create_order
tools.description: Create an order for a branded IPFS gateway on your own domain. Returns order_id, exact_amount_usdt and pay_to_address. Payment is on-chain and irreversible: verify domain and cid before paying, then send exactly exact_amount_usdt USDT on TRON (TRC20) within 15 minutes.

tools.name: portvan_order_status
tools.description: Check an order: pending, paid, expired or needs_review. Poll every 5-10 seconds after paying.
